gpu_tip: ~34GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: smaller than the K-quants at the same bit width and imatrix-calibrated, at the cost of more CPU work per token, so it rewards putting as many layers on the GPU as will fit. An 8GB GPU plus a 32GB DDR5 kit runs it.
mac_tip: Needs ~34GB — fits a 36GB MacBook Pro; a 48GB config leaves real headroom.
